description: Read an agent's job contract: its current version per workload (objective, unit of work, acceptance criteria, KPI target, budget, owner, human baseline, and the vendor terms: vendor, billable unit, and the vendor's own definition of resolved, which is labelled "the vendor's definition, not verified") and the full append-only version history. An agent with no contract returns an explicit empty state with the next action. Read-only. Requires an API key with the 'read' scope.

agent_key.description: The agent_key (the X-Agent-ID string), not the UUID

title: Get Job Contract
